title: KHADI PRODUCTS TO CAPF
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

KHADI PRODUCTS TO CAPF

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
28 JUL 2026 3:19PM by PIB Delhi

In order to promote the procurement and daily use of  Swadeshi and Khadi products, Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) has been registered with Kendriya Police Kalyan Bhandar (KPKB) since 13th March 2020. Also a  number of steps have been taken in the direction:-

(i)  Four items, i.e (i) Mustard Oil (ii) Cotton Bed Durries (iii) Woolen Blanket and (iv) Bed Sheet and Pillow Cover have been identified for procurement by CAPFs from Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC).

(ii)      ITBP is the Nodal Force for procurement of Mustard Oil and Durries. CRPF is the Nodal Force for procurement of Blankets, and ADG (Medical), CAPFs, is the Nodal for the procurement of Bed Sheet and Pillow Cover.

(iii)     Swadeshi and Khadi products are also being sold through Master Bhandars and Subsidiary Bhandars of KPKB for the benefit of serving and retired personnel of CAPFs all over India.

(iv)     Daily use items are procured by the CAPFs from the KVIC.

(v)      The National Bee Board is continuously providing necessary support and training to all forces for scientific beekeeping. Gardens are being developed within the premises of the Central Armed Police Forces by planting more flowering plants to create a suitable environment for honey production. Honey produced through beekeeping is being used as food for the soldiers to enhance their health and immunity.

Under Vibrant Village Programme-II (VVP-II), CAPFs have started procuring edible items such as fruits, vegetables, dairy products, dry rations and meats from Self-Help Groups (SHGs) & State Cooperative Societies of border areas.

The comprehensive details of the Civic Action Programme (CAP) allocations and welfare activities conducted by the CAPFs in border areas are given at annexure-I. In addition to above, allocations and welfare activities conducted CAP particularly in Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts are given at annexure II & III respectively.

ANNEXURE - I

Repairs to community buildings, viz, schools, hospitals, health centers, community hall etc.

Constructions of tracks, small bridges, culverts, mines, cableway, water supply, electrification schemes, playground etc.

Running of health, medical, dental, veterinary camps which include providing of medical equipment and stores etc. to existing hospitals nursing homes.

Human Resources Development to include imparting of vocational training, conduct of educational excursions to students to places of national interest and to organize career counseling training and coaching etc.

Initiation of small projects in improvement and care of livestock, beekeepeing, fisheries, agricultural techniques, orchards, forestry carpet and or handloom weaving, history etc.

Sanitation and Hygiene through Extension Services and social education.

Drinking water basic precaution and system of storage.

Development of sources of non-conventional energy.

Development of handicraft and cottage industries.

Assistance during Natural Calamities.

Water harvesting structure.

Sports facilities.

Distribution of Transistor.

Pre-recruitment training.

Implementation of ‘Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan’ for which activities include programmes to sensitize the people through higher educational institutions, university campuses and schools by organizing cultural and sports events in coordination with NGOs and master volunteers working in field.

Provisions of a standard set of community use items such as cooking utensils, basic furniture (chairs, tables), shamiyanas etc.

Provision of computer and furniture to Schools.

Cost of transportation of stores for execution of the above-mentioned tasks.
